messages:
James: :rotating_light: CVE-2026-0007 in libfoo (runtime dependency). Remote RCE PoC exists and matches our deployed runtime. Affects Dedicated + Private images.

James: Need triage + backport plan for Dedicated/Private ASAP — private customers often require signed images and have KMS verification. Any blockers?

Matt: I can own the cherry-pick + image build. Rough ETA 24h if no blockers.

Sofia: For on-prem we cannot push unsigned images. Several customers verify signature + digest against their own KMS. Who can sign with the prod key?

Eva: Security: severity HIGH. Exploit is trivial with default config. Recommend hotfix for Dedicated, and patch bundles for Private customers.

Matt: Proposed workflow:
```
git checkout -b hotfix/cve-2026-0007
git cherry-pick <commit-sha>
make build-runtime-image VERSION=v1.12.3-hotfix-cve-2026-0007
docker push registry.redwood.internal/runtime:v1.12.3-hotfix-cve-2026-0007
```
Then sign artifacts and publish signing metadata.

Sofia: For Private customers we should produce two deliverables:
- signed image (for customers who accept our signed artifact)
- patch bundle + build instructions (for customers who build internally)

Oliver: Support note: we need per-customer guidance. Some customers pin image digest; others pin tag+verify signature. Can we generate customer-specific tags if needed?

James: Decision checklist:
1) create hotfix branch + cherry-pick (agree)
2) publish signed images for Hosted/Dedicated
3) produce patch bundle + signing metadata for Private customers who maintain their own KMS
4) RBAC: restrict signing approvals to SecEng + Infra leads; ensure every signing action is audited

Eva: RBAC request: require 2 approvers for production signing key usage. Also ensure signing events are logged to audit.logs with 365d retention.

Matt: I'll open the GH PR and start the cherrypick. Need list of approvers/names for signing.

James: Approvers for this hotfix: @Eva and @Matt (temporary). @Sofia to coordinate on-prem key handling with customers.

deploy-bot: image push succeeded: registry.redwood.internal/runtime:v1.12.3-hotfix-cve-2026-0007 :white_check_mark:

Matt: Pushed signed image and uploaded artifacts to s3://redwood-sec/hotfixes/cve-2026-0007. Runbook created: https://go/repo/runbooks/cve-2026-0007

Sofia: I'll draft the Private deployment guide + verification script. Example verify snippet:
```
# verify signature
ktrust verify --key /path/to/customer-kms-key --sig /path/to/pubsig
```
Will add FIPS notes where required.

Oliver: I created customer advisory tickets and an email template. Will hold on send until we have two approvals and image push confirmed.

James: Applying priority: P0 for Dedicated (must ship), P1 for Private (bundle + docs). Eva please confirm.

Eva: Confirmed P0 Dedicated, P1 Private.

James: Creating tickets: SEC-3845 (hotfix branch & image), SEC-3846 (signing policy & RBAC), SEC-3847 (private patch bundle & docs). Assigning owners.

Sofia: Note: a few on-prem customers require FIPS-signed artifacts. We'll need to validate signature format and include FIPS key profile testing in the pipeline.

Matt: Acknowledged — will run signing tests against FIPS profile in CI before publishing.

James: Thanks all. I'll close the loop after audit logs show two approvals and the signed image is available. :lock:
